categories.main_business_segments: Shaanxi Huaqin Technology Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in special functional materials, aerospace parts intelligent processing and manufacturing, acoustic metamaterials and instruments, ceramic matrix composites for aerospace, and ultra-fine grain components manufacturing. The company also engages in related technical services and testing, with subsidiaries focusing on specific segments such as aerospace parts, acoustic materials, and ceramic composites.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in mid-to-high temperature special functional materials, multi-spectrum compatible materials, structural-functional integrated composites, high-efficiency thermal barrier materials, heavy anti-corrosion materials, electromagnetic shielding materials, and acoustic metamaterials. Production methods include customized coating processes, composite material fabrication, precision aerospace parts machining, and laser ultrasonic non-destructive testing. It also employs advanced manufacturing techniques such as chemical vapor deposition and flexible machining for complex aerospace components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in the aerospace industry, including aviation and aerospace equipment manufacturers. The company also serves sectors such as energy, environmental protection, industrial production, transportation, and high-end equipment manufacturing. Its products are used in aircraft engines, aerospace structures, power generation, and precision instruments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and major subsidiaries located in Shaanxi, Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Liaoning provinces. It serves domestic aerospace and industrial markets, with no significant overseas operations reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huaqin Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace materials supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and processing of advanced materials and components. It acts as a key supplier of specialized materials and precision parts to aerospace manufacturers and related industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in special functional materials and aerospace new materials, deepening 'industry-university-research-application' collaboration. R&D priorities include developing wide temperature range and multi-spectrum compatible materials, structural-functional integrated composites, acoustic metamaterials, ceramic matrix composites, and ultra-fine grain metals. It aims to enhance product quality, production efficiency, and expand applications in aerospace and high-end equipment sectors, supported by significant R&D investment and strategic partnerships with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of special functional materials, aerospace parts manufacturing services, acoustic metamaterials and instruments, and technical services including testing and inspection. The company uses a direct sales model, often engaging in customized production based on client specifications, and recognizes revenue upon delivery and client acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huaqin Technology is positioned as a leading innovative enterprise in China's aerospace new materials industry, with a strong domestic market presence and technological advantages in special functional materials. It holds a first-mover advantage in several specialized material segments and maintains close collaborations with major aerospace customers. The company faces competition from both domestic and international advanced materials suppliers but benefits from high entry barriers and stringent qualification requirements in its niche.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, representing a 24.17% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 414 million, up 23.56%. Total assets reached RMB 6.05 billion, growing 17.15% from the previous year. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity, increased R&D investment, and diversified product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huaqin Technology offers unique value through its comprehensive portfolio of advanced aerospace materials that combine high performance across temperature ranges, multi-spectrum compatibility, and structural-functional integration. Its products enhance the durability, efficiency, and performance of aerospace components under extreme conditions. The company differentiates itself with proprietary technologies, rigorous quality control, strong customer service, and the ability to provide integrated solutions from material design to manufacturing and testing, meeting stringent aerospace industry standards.
